description: Land Aquisition - Tellipalai East, Valikamam North D/S Devision, Jaffna District. (Section-05)
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain land parcels are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and claimants, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification type.
